reason: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and the Salisbury Zoo is free and already our Saturday thing. I'd maybe take the free first visit, but I wouldn't pay $15 every weekend when I only get Saturdays.
objection: Weekends only means I'd be paying the higher $15 rate, plus the drive and gas, for something the free zoo already covers.
would_change_my_mind: A very cheap or free weekend rate, or it being close enough that the drive isn't a factor.
